note: FNS Section 1062 is a QC variance determination procedure, not a caseworker policy requirement. Steps A-E describe how a QC reviewer audits unearned income: comparing verified amounts to worksheet amounts, correcting for worker error or household misreporting, determining excludability, and deciding which amount to use in error determination. These are audit methodology steps with no caseworker equivalent. The only policy content — the $125 change reporting threshold for unearned income — is thoroughly covered in the OLG across multiple pages: Change Reporting – Overview (Income-Related Changes), Simplified Reporting – Interim Report (What Changes Must be Verified), Simplified Reporting – Examples (Reporting Requirements), and SNAP COLA (Reporting Requirement Threshold). The OLG also covers BEACON procedures for entering and changing unearned income data (Entering, Changing, and Ending Other (Unearned) Income Data page with Prospective Tab and Source Tab sections). The QC-specific procedures in Steps A-E are appropriately absent from a caseworker guide.
